result:
I’d make it impossible to genuinely believe other people matter less than you.

Not forced niceness—just a deep, unshakeable recognition of other people’s reality. I think a huge amount of cruelty, exploitation, apathy, and violence becomes possible only when other minds become abstract, distant, or lesser. If that illusion broke, many systems would have to change immediately.
